name: qvac-notetaker
description: Local, private AI notetaker for Windows powered by QVAC SDK
author: Nikita Manshin

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web

//overrides: Do NOT stub @qvac/* native packages. The SDK worker (bare runtime) eagerly imports every plugin at boot from server/bare/plugins/index.js, so even unused ones must resolve to real modules. A CJS stub breaks bare's ESM loader and the worker exits with code 1 before IPC comes up. Slimming is done exclusively by scripts/prune-modules.cjs, which removes foreign-platform prebuilds (darwin/linux/ios/android) and source maps — that's still ~50% of the install.
